notes.subject: תשגה
notes.rationale: deliberate repetition of שגה from v19 — same verb for the wife's love and the stranger; parallel lost in translation

notes.subject: בזרה / נכריה
notes.rationale: 'strange woman' is the adulteress figure of Proverbs 1-9; literal 'foreign/estranged woman' vs euphemistic 'adulteress'

notes.subject: pikinini man bilong mi
notes.rationale: direct address of the father to the son, addressee named in the verse

notes.subject: bilong wanem
notes.rationale: rhetorical question drawing the son to examine his own desire

translation: Na bilong wanem, pikinini man bilong mi, yu ken lostu long meri bilong narapela man, na yu holim pas long bodi bilong meri bilong narapela ples?
